entry.name: rnbo_out
entry.description: Indexed event outlet from RNBO. Creates corresponding outlets on the rnbo~ object that will pass a bang, number, or list out of the RNBO patch. In the exported code, creates a message tag like the outport object where the tag takes the form out1 , where out refers to the outlet and is the index of that outlet.
